title: Day 22: Seller Closing Costs & Estimating Net Proceeds
excerpt: Sellers typically cover the owner’s title policy, their share of prorations, and negotiated commissions or concessions.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “seller closing costs Texas”, “how much will I net from selling my house Austin”, and “real estate commission and costs Austin” want a local, practical answer.

Sellers typically cover the owner’s title policy, their share of prorations, and negotiated commissions or concessions. Total costs often land in the 7–10% range of sale price depending on commission structure, repairs, and concessions.

A net sheet prepared early—updated with actual offers—prevents surprises.

Texas homestead and capital-gains rules can affect the final tax picture; professional advice is recommended for larger gains or complex situations.
